title: Block visuals that contradict the approved copy
starting_state: A slide image or visual plan is stylish and identity-consistent.
The visible clothing, gaze, object state, or action contradicts the exact approved slide text.
done_when: Visual QA blocks copy-visual contradictions before proof or final approval.
Each slide plan records the copy claim and the visible evidence that proves it.
Attractive style or identity match cannot override broken scene logic.
forbidden_changes: Do not treat style, identity, or dimensions as enough when scene logic fails.
Do not edit approved copy to fit a wrong image unless the creator reopens copy.
Do not accept vague 'matches vibe' QA.
fail_to_pass: visual plans and QA fail when visible action/object/clothing/gaze contradicts exact slide copy
pass_to_pass: style-correct and identity-correct images still pass when visible scene evidence proves the copy
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should use a different contradiction such as looking at the wrong person, already-worn clothing, missing object movement, or cause/effect reversal.
